description: USB Gym (package usbg) is a CT-based Gymnasium testbed for closed-loop ultrasound probe view matching. For any probe pose over a patient's labeled CT it renders a B-mode frame and resolves probe-skin contact in MuJoCo; an agent moves the probe to reproduce a target view of the same patient. Renderer, texture stage, mask source, controller, reward and anatomy source are plug slots with small interfaces, and an oracle ladder of privileged and image-only controllers locates the remaining pose error. The release includes the plug adapters and their admission gate, the organ-segmenter trainer, the test suite and the data-preparation scripts for the public datasets. Every closed-loop result is in simulation.
